identityFirewall.rule: HeroCel may render Elijah's features, but may not resize, reshape, reposition, or substitute them with calibration-master geometry.
identityFirewall.meaningOfHeroCelStyleApplicationPercent: Apply the complete HeroCel rendering grammar to the geometry supplied by Elijah likeness and Prismel design authorities. This percentage grants zero geometry ownership.

facialSurfaceRendering.rule: Render Elijah's unchanged face geometry with cleaner animated surface modeling.
facialSurfaceRendering.eyes: increase edge clarity, catchlight readability, iris/pupil contrast, and lid definition without changing Elijah's eye dimensions or spacing
facialSurfaceRendering.skin: smooth broad value groups with restrained painterly highlights and no pore-level realism
facialSurfaceRendering.nose: simplify light and shadow planes only; geometry remains Elijah-owned
facialSurfaceRendering.mouth: clean contour and shadow separation only; lip proportions and smile geometry remain Elijah-owned
facialSurfaceRendering.cheeksJawChin: simplify shading noise only; facial contour remains Elijah-owned
